title: Ajwa Water Park & Gardens Vadodara - A Perfect Family Getaway for Fun and Relaxation
content:
Ajwa Water Park & Gardens Vadodara

If you’re looking for a refreshing escape from the city heat, Ajwa Water Park & Gardens in Vadodara, Gujarat is the ultimate destination for fun, thrill, and nature. Combining thrilling water rides with lush green gardens, it’s a perfect weekend spot for families, friends, and adventure seekers alike.

About Ajwa Water Park & Gardens

Located around 22 km from Vadodara, the Ajwa Water Park is one of the most popular amusement destinations in Gujarat. Spread over a large area, it offers a mix of exciting water slides, wave pools, and relaxing landscaped gardens. The park is part of the famous Ajwa Fun World, making it a complete entertainment zone for people of all ages.

The adjoining Ajwa Gardens enhance the experience with beautifully maintained lawns, musical fountains, and a peaceful environment - ideal for evening strolls or picnics.

Attractions and Activities

  • Wave Pool: Enjoy the feeling of beach waves in a safe, family-friendly environment.
  • Water Slides: Thrilling rides like Spiral Slides, Speed Coasters, and Family Slides for all age groups.
  • Kiddies Pool: A safe play zone designed especially for children.
  • Rain Dance: Dance to upbeat music under artificial rain - a visitor favorite!
  • Ajwa Garden: A serene space with fountains, sculptures, and flowerbeds for those who prefer relaxation over thrill rides.
  • Ajwa Fun World: The amusement park adjacent to the water park offers dry rides, a toy train, and a mini amusement zone.

Best Time to Visit

The best time to visit Ajwa Water Park is between March and June or during the winter months (October to February). Summers are ideal for water activities, while winters are perfect for enjoying the gardens and rides comfortably.

Entry Fee and Timings

Ajwa Water Park Entry Fee:
Rs.450 - Rs.650 per person (approx., varies by season and age)

Ajwa Gardens Entry Fee:
Rs.30 - Rs.50 per person

Timings:
10:00 AM - 6:00 PM (Water Park)
9:00 AM - 8:00 PM (Garden)

Closed on: Tuesdays (subject to maintenance schedule)

How to Reach

  • By Road: Located about 22 km from Vadodara city center; you can hire a taxi or drive via Ajwa Road.
  • By Train: Vadodara Junction is the nearest major railway station.
  • By Air: Vadodara Airport is around 25 km away.

Facilities Available

  • On-site restaurants and snack counters
  • Locker and changing room facilities
  • Parking area for visitors
  • First-aid center and lifeguards for safety

Nearby Attractions

  • Ajwa Reservoir - Known for scenic views and calm surroundings.
  • EME Temple - A unique architectural landmark in Vadodara. Read more..
  • Sayaji Baug - A famous garden with a zoo and planetarium. Read more..
  • Laxmi Vilas Palace - A royal marvel showcasing the Gaekwad dynasty’s heritage. Read more..

Travel Tips

  • Carry swimwear and an extra set of clothes.
  • Follow all safety instructions during rides.
  • Visit early to avoid long queues at popular slides.
  • Weekdays are less crowded than weekends.
excerpt: Ajwa Water Park & Gardens in Vadodara is a vibrant mix of adventure and tranquility. With thrilling water rides, musical fountains, and lush green lawns, it’s a must-visit destination for families and travelers seeking a fun-filled day in Gujarat.
